data.name: Hotel Safi Metropolitan
data.address: Av Lázaro Cárdenas 2400, Valle Oriente, 66260 San Pedro Garza García, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
In a modern building complex off Federal Highway 85, this upscale hotel features distant views of the Cerro San Rafael mountain peak. It's a minute’s walk from the shops and restaurants at the Metropolitan Center, and 5 km from both Macroplaza square and the Museum of Contemporary Art of Monterrey.
The sleek, contemporary rooms have Wi-Fi, smart TVs, minbars and Nespresso machines, as well as sitting areas. Upgraded rooms and suites add city and mountain views. Room service is available 24/7.
Amenities include a heated outdoor pool with a hot tub and a waterslide, plus a gym and a spa. Parking and a breakfast buffet are also available.
